label: rem:hadron-level-knot-table
title: Hadron-level knot decomposition table for nucleons and atoms
html:
The hadron-level representation captures the same Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M and Frobenius stability as the full quark-level braid word, but with 6 coefficients per atom instead of thousands. Each atom decomposes into the six-element NF basis \{\gamma, \sigma_0, \sigma_1, L_+, L_-, e^-\} of H_3(q).

  \mathrm{NF}(Z,N) = \sum_{b \in \mathcal{B}} c_b(Z,N) \cdot b,
  \qquad
  \mathrm{tr}_M = \sum_b c_b \, z^{|b|}

See Table: Hadron-level knot decomposition for nucleons + 14 atoms.

All 19 atoms pass the Frobenius positivity check (G \cdot \vec{c} \geq 0), confirming that the hadron-level NF lies in the physical cone of H_3(q).

The NF coefficients for each atom (6 values) are in the computation witness hadron-knot-table.witness.json.
